name: neuronto-agent-finder
description: Find the MCP servers, skills, agents and APIs that can do a task. Searches every public Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) registry at once, from inside VS Code.

commands.title: Neuronto: Find a tool, MCP server or agent for a task

neuronto.endpoint.markdownDescription: MCP endpoint to register. Point this at any other public ARD registry's MCP endpoint to use that one instead; the list is at [neuronto.com/ard-registries](https://neuronto.com/ard-registries).

neuronto.searchEndpoint.markdownDescription: REST endpoint used by the **Find a tool** command.

neuronto.federate.description: Search every other public ARD registry as well as this index, and fuse the rankings. Turning this off keeps the query on one index.
